name: Pera Xtreme
tagline: The road to IEEEXtreme — 24 hours, one global leaderboard.
summary: IEEEXtreme is a 24-hour global coding competition held on the same day in locations around the world, organised by IEEE. Pera Xtreme is how the branch gets Peradeniya’s teams ready — awareness sessions, practice contests like CodeVortex, proctoring and a night-long coding arcade on campus.

stats.label: max membership sponsorship for top CodeVortex teams

sections.heading: What is IEEEXtreme?
sections.body: Each year thousands of enthusiasts, coders and students of all levels with IEEE Student Membership take part in this internationally recognised challenge to win valuable prizes. The Peradeniya branch runs a full pathway into it — starting with “Path to Xtreme: the what, why and how of IEEEXtreme” awareness sessions.

sections.heading: Pera.Xtreme CodeVortex
sections.body: A six-hour coding frenzy held each September to turbocharge preparation. Face off in intense challenges, sharpen your skills — and the top three teams can win sponsorship of 50% to 75% of the IEEE Student Membership fee if they commit to IEEEXtreme.

sections.heading: How to compete
sections.body: Everything you need to go from zero to the global leaderboard.

points.text: Team up — create a team of up to three members, each with an active IEEE student or graduate membership.
Find a proctor — ask a registered proctor from the student branch to supervise your team.
Get added to the University of Peradeniya team listing.
Register your team on the IEEEXtreme portal using the branch’s ambassador referral ID.
Practice, practice, practice — follow the branch’s training plan and practice rounds.

sections.heading: Bittopia 2023
sections.body: Bittopia, the coding arcade under Xtreme.Pera-23, kicked off at 05:30 AM Sri Lanka time at the Faculty of Engineering alongside the global start at 00:00 UTC — with seven teams in person and three more joining remotely.
